items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Ken came up and played a number with us on the clarinet

ctx.x: You were playing your own stuff?

I was playing my own stuff and then when we got through playing--what we did was we played two numbers and then Ken came up and played a number with us on the clarinet, and then we played three or four numbers with Tip, Tap and Toe; they were in the show, and then we played--we ended up with the Saints, or something like that, (inaudible).
That would have been the finale.
